CREATE TABLE "public"."card_items" (
  "acquired_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "listing_id" int4,
  "offer_id" int4,
  "owner_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "photo_card_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "card_items_status_check_80844175" CHECK ("status" IN ('HELD', 'ON_SALE', 'OFFERED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."creation_logs" (
  "created_count" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "year_month" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."exchange_offers" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "listing_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "offered_card_item_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "offerer_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "exchange_offers_status_check_d2074f89" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_read" bool NOT NULL,
  "link" text NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_type_check_d9525f4c" CHECK ("type" IN ('SIGNUP', 'OFFER_RECEIVED', 'OFFER_ACCEPTED', 'OFFER_REJECTED', 'PURCHASE_COMPLETED', 'SALE_COMPLETED', 'SOLD_OUT', 'LISTING_UPDATED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."photo_cards" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creator_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "genre" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" int4 NOT NULL,
  "total_quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "photo_cards_genre_check_6cc1e4b5" CHECK ("genre" IN ('LANDSCAPE', 'PORTRAIT', 'ANIMAL', 'PLANT', 'OBJECT', 'ETC')),
  CONSTRAINT "photo_cards_method_check_9a7762d3" CHECK ("method" IN ('PHOTO', 'CRAFT', 'AI', 'ETC')),
  CONSTRAINT "photo_cards_price_range_c521b70e" CHECK ("price" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."point_histories" (
  "amount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "balance_after" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "idempotency_key" text,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "point_histories_balance_after_nonnegative_6fffd8c7" CHECK ("balance_after" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "point_histories_reason_check_dbb7e44f" CHECK ("reason" IN ('SIGNUP', 'PURCHASE', 'SALE', 'RANDOM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."random_point_logs" (
  "draw_date" date NOT NULL,
  "earned_points" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "used_count" int4 NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "random_point_logs_used_count_max_2835319b" CHECK ("used_count" <= 3)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refresh_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sale_listings" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "exchange_description" text NOT NULL,
  "exchange_genre" text NOT NULL,
  "exchange_method" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "photo_card_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "price" int4 NOT NULL,
  "remaining_quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sale_quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "seller_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sale_listings_exchange_genre_check_5fe27ace" CHECK ("exchange_genre" IN ('LANDSCAPE', 'PORTRAIT', 'ANIMAL', 'PLANT', 'OBJECT', 'ETC')),
  CONSTRAINT "sale_listings_exchange_method_check_ca76d0b3" CHECK ("exchange_method" IN ('PHOTO', 'CRAFT', 'AI', 'ETC')),
  CONSTRAINT "sale_listings_price_range_c521b70e" CHECK ("price" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  CONSTRAINT "sale_listings_quantity_bounds_279e31ff" CHECK ("sale_quantity" > 0 AND "remaining_quantity" <= "sale_quantity"),
  CONSTRAINT "sale_listings_remaining_nonnegative_1012e92c" CHECK ("remaining_quantity" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "sale_listings_status_check_32a7d91e" CHECK ("status" IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT', 'CANCELED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."trades" (
  "counterpart_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "photo_card_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "points" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "received_photo_card_id" int4,
  "seller_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "trades_quantity_points_valid_3837e16a" CHECK ("quantity" > 0 AND "points" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "trades_type_check_e811fb8e" CHECK ("type" IN ('PURCHASE', 'EXCHANGE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "google_id" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nickname" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text,
  "points" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_points_nonnegative_2f2703ae" CHECK ("points" >= 0)
)
